description: Rescan every project from disk and rebuild the index. Rarely needed: each call already re-indexes what changed on disk. For a project added since startup, or edits made outside on a project whose `freshness.diskTracking` is 'off'.

cold.description: Also read every installed plugin again, ignoring the cache (slower; default false).

name: refresh
title: Re-index projects from disk (full rescan)
